description: verification-report.md's Regression Table row for hl-trade reads '42 | PASS', but the actual raw pytest transcript it cites (verification/proof-harnesses/regression-hltrade.txt) shows '41 passed, 1 skipped in 0.12s' (42 collected). The skip is legitimately documented in the same raw file (hyperliquid-python-sdk not installed in this interpreter; covered by an equivalent static-grep test and by Phase-5 live E2E per the skip's own inline reason string) and this is an unrelated-feature blast-radius check this feature never edits -- but the report table's own 'PASS' label at count '42' slightly overstates what the raw evidence actually shows (41 pass + 1 skip, not 42 pass).
notes: Non-blocking: the skip is pre-existing, disclosed, and orthogonal to this feature's own scope (self-improve-real-ledger never touches hl-trade/**). Raw evidence (regression-hltrade.txt) itself is accurate and internally consistent; only the summary table's rounding of '41 passed + 1 documented skip' to a bare '42 | PASS' is imprecise.
